command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final
export LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER=gabriel FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION=gabriel PYTHONPATH=$ROOT/scripts
python3 - <<'PY'
import inspect, json
import voice_final_runtime as v
s=v.base.stern
print('STERN_FILE',getattr(s,'__file__',None))
fn=getattr(s,'_f2wp1207_turn_loop_auto',None)
print('AUTO_CALLABLE',callable(fn))
if callable(fn):
 print('AUTO_SIGNATURE',inspect.signature(fn))
 src=inspect.getsource(fn)
 print('AUTO_SOURCE_BEGIN')
 print(src[:9000])
 print('AUTO_SOURCE_END')
print('DB_PATH',getattr(s,'DB_PATH',None))
conn=None
try:
 conn=s.schreib_verbindung() if hasattr(s,'schreib_verbindung') else None
 if conn is not None:
  table=conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='f2_grid10_turn_pointer'").fetchone()
  print('POINTER_TABLE',bool(table))
  if table:
   row=conn.execute("SELECT pointer_id,runtime_epoch_id,session_id,frame_id,turn_event_id,reentry_kind_used,created_at FROM f2_grid10_turn_pointer ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
   print('LATEST_POINTER',json.dumps(list(row) if row else None,ensure_ascii=False))
finally:
 if conn is not None: conn.close()
PY
